pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa asubhasamāpattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.5: n' amhi kenaci upasaṃkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.6: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā nāssu 'dha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṃkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.7: bhikkhū bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa asubhasamāpattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.9: te sakena kāyena aṭṭiyanti harāyanti jigucchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.10: seyyathāpi nāma itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃ nhāto ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭiyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.11: evam eva te bhikkhū sakena kāyena aṭṭiyantā harāyantā jigucchantā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.12: attanāpi attānaṃ jīvitā voropenti aññamaññaṃ pi jīvitā voropenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.13: Migalaṇḍikaṃ pi samaṇakuttakaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.16: atha kho Migalaṇḍiko samaṇakuttako pattacīvarehi bhaṭo sambahule bhikkhū jīvitā voropetvā lohitagataṃ asiṃ ādāya yena Vaggumudā nadī ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.17: atha kho Migalaṇḍikassa samaṇakuttakassa lohitagataṃ asiṃ dhovantassa ahud eva kukkuccaṃ ahū vippaṭisāro:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.18: alābhā vata me na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me na vata me suladdhaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.19: bahuṃ vata mayā apuññaṃ pasutaṃ yo 'haṃ bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme jīvitā voropesin ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.20: atha kho aññatarā Mārakāyikā devatā abhijjamāne udake āgantvā Migalaṇḍikaṃ samaṇakuttakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.21: sādhu sādhu sappurisa, lābhā te sappurisa, suladdhaṃ te sappurisa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.22: bahuṃ tayā sappurisa puññaṃ pasutaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ atiṇṇe tāresīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.24: lābhā kira me, suladdhaṃ kira me, bahuṃ kira mayā puññaṃ pasutaṃ, atiṇṇe kirāhaṃ tāremīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.25: tikkhaṃ asiṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ pariveṇena pariveṇaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.27: tattha ye te bhikkhū avītarāgā tesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hoti yeva bhayaṃ hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti lomahaṃso,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.28: ye pana te bhikkhū vītarāgā tesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye na hoti bhayaṃ na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti lomahaṃso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.1.29: atha kho Migalaṇḍiko samaṇakuttako ekaṃ pi bhikkhuṃ ekāhena jīvitā voropesi dve pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi tayo pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi cattāro pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi pañca pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi dasa pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi vīsatiṃ pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi tiṃsaṃ pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi cattārīsaṃ pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi paññāsaṃ pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi saṭṭhiṃ pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa addhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.2: kiṃ nu kho Ānanda tanubhūto viya bhikkhusaṃgho 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.3: tathā hi pana bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa asubhasamāpattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.4: te ca bhante bhikkhū bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa asubhasamāpattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti te anekākāravokāraṃ asubhabhāvanānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.5: te sakena kāyena aṭṭiyanti harāyanti jigucchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.6: seyyathāpi nāma itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃ nhāto ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭiyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.7: evam eva te bhikkhū sakena kāyena aṭṭiyantā harāyantā jigucchantā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.8: attanāpi attānaṃ jīvitā voropenti aññamaññaṃ pi jīvitā voropenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.9: Migalaṇḍikaṃ pi samaṇakuttakaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.12: atha kho bhante Migalaṇḍiko samaṇakuttako pattacīvarehi bhaṭo ekaṃ pi bhikkhuṃ ekāhena jīvitā voropesi --pa-- saṭṭhiṃ pi bhikkhū ekāhena jīvitā voropesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.13: sādhu bhante bhagavā aññaṃ pariyāyaṃ ācikkhatu yathāyaṃ bhikkhusaṃgho aññāya saṇṭhaheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.14: tena h' Ānanda yāvatikā bhikkhū Vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.16: kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā yāvatikā bhikkhū Vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.18: yassa dāni bhante bhagavā kālaṃ maññasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.2.19: atha kho bhagavā yena upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.1: ayaṃ pi kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c' eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ tam enaṃ mahā akālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c' eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.4: kathaṃ bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi kathañ ca bahulīkato santo c' eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhuñjitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.7: dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto dīghaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.8: rassaṃ vā assasanto rassaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto rassaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.9: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.10: passambhayaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.3.23: evaṃ bhāvito kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato santo c' eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasametīti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.2: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū attanāpi attānaṃ jīvitā voropenti aññamaññaṃ pi jīvitā voropenti Migalaṇḍikaṃ pi samaṇakuttakaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.3: sādhu no āvuso jīvitā voropehi, idan te pattacīvaraṃ bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.6: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.7: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave bhikkhū attanāpi . . . voropessanti . . . vakkhanti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.9: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.10: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.11.1: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:1.4.13: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||4||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako gilāno hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.2: tassa pajāpatī abhirūpā hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tassā itthiyā paṭibaddhacittā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.4: atha kho chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.5: sace kho so āvuso upāsako jīvissati na mayan taṃ itthiṃ labhissāma,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.6: handa mayaṃ āvuso tassa upāsakassa maraṇavaṇṇaṃ saṃvaṇṇemā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.7: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yena so upāsako ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.8: tvaṃ kho 'si upāsaka katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo akatapāpo akataluddho akatakibbiso,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.9: kataṃ tayā kalyāṇaṃ akataṃ tayā pāpaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.12: ito tvaṃ kālaṃkato kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissasi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.13: tattha dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāressasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.16: ahañ hi katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo akatapāpo akataluddho akatakibbiso,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.17: kataṃ mayā kalyāṇaṃ akataṃ mayā pāpaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.20: ito ahaṃ kālaṃkato kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.21: tattha dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāressāmīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.22: so asappāyāni c' eva bhojanāni bhuñji asappāyāni ca khādaniyāni khādi asappāyāni sāyaniyāni sāyi asappāyāni pānāni pivi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.23: tassa asappāyāni c' eva bhojanāni bhuñjato asappāyāni ca khādaniyāni khādato asappāyāni sāyaniyāni sāyato asappāyāni pānāni pivato kharo ābādho uppajji,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.24: so ten' eva ābādhena kālaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.26: alajjino ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dussīlā musāvādino.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.27: ime hi nāma dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā paṭijānissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.28: n' atthi imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ n' atthi imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.29: naṭṭhaṃ imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ naṭṭhaṃ imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ, kuto imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ kuto imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ, apagatā ime sāmaññā apagatā ime brāhmaññā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.38: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.39: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.40: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upāsakassa maraṇavaṇṇaṃ saṃvaṇṇessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.41: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --la--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.42: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave upāsakassa maraṇavaṇṇaṃ saṃvaṇṇethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.45: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisā ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.46: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā upāsakassa maraṇavaṇṇaṃ saṃvaṇṇessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.47: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.48: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.49.1: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.50: ambho purisa kiṃ tuyh' iminā pāpakena dujjīvitena matan te jīvitā seyyo 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:2.51: iticittamano cittasaṃkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya maraṇāya vā samādapeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.8: yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ yāva maraṇakālā, etthantare eso manussaviggaho nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.12: asiṃ vā sattiṃ vā bheṇḍiṃ vā laguḷaṃ vā pāsāṇaṃ vā satthaṃ vā visaṃ vā rajjuṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.14: jīvite ādīnavaṃ dasseti maraṇe vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.16: satthaṃ vā āhara visaṃ vā khāda rajjuyā vā ubbandhitvā kālaṃ karohīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.21: aḍḍhānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya daliddānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.22: sadhanānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya adhanānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.23: devānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya manussānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.25: hatthacchinnassa pādacchinnassa hatthapādacchinnassa kaṇṇacchinnassa nāsacchinnassa kaṇṇanāsacchinnassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.26: iminā ca pāpakena iminā ca dujjīvitena matan te jīvitā seyyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.28: yaṃ cittaṃ taṃ mano, yaṃ mano taṃ cittaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.35: ito tvaṃ kālaṃkato kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.36: tattha dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāressasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.38: satthaṃ vā āhara visaṃ vā khāda rajjuyā vā ubbandhitvā kālaṃ karohi sobbhe vā narake vā papāte vā papatā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.42: seyyathāpi nāma puthusilā dvedhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.43: evam eva bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropetvā asamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.46: saṃvāso nāma ekakammaṃ ekuddeso samasikkhātā, eso saṃvāso nāma,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.47: so tena saddhiṃ n' atthi, tena vuccati asaṃvāso 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:4.1.1: sāmaṃ, adhiṭṭhāya, dūtena, dūtaparamparāya, visakkiyena dūtena, gatapaccāgatena dūtena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:4.1.11: opātaṃ, apassenaṃ, upanikkhipanaṃ, bhesajjaṃ, rūpūpahāro, saddūpahāro, gandhūpahāro, rasūpahāro, phoṭṭhabbūpahāro, dhammūpahāro, ācikkhanā, anusāsanī, saṃketakammaṃ, nimittakamman ti. ||1||
